'''TCGMix''' is a fan-run website for playing collectible and expandable card games in a web browser. It offers dedicated game pages and a separate directory of games in playtest, including a prototype for Decipher's [[Star Wars CCG]].<ref name="home" /><ref name="playtests" />

== Star Wars CCG prototype ==

The Star Wars CCG page offers rooms for games against another player and an option to play against a bot. Its card archive and public deck lists are open to visitors. Players sign in to save decks or play.<ref name="starwars" /> TCGMix lists the game among its beta playtests and features ''Young Jedi CCG'' separately.<ref name="home" />

== Other games ==

The site's featured games include ''Young Jedi CCG'', ''Stargate TCG'', ''Harry Potter TCG'' and ''Star Trek CCG First Edition''. The playtest directory includes Decipher's ''Star Trek CCG Second Edition'', ''Jedi Knights TCG'' and ''WARS Trading Card Game''. It also lists games from other publishers, including ''Babylon 5 CCG'', ''Buffy the Vampire Slayer CCG'' and ''The Lord of the Rings: The Card Game''.<ref name="home" /><ref name="playtests" />

TCGMix says it charges no fees and takes no real-money payments. Its website describes cards and progress rewards as earned through play, with in-game credits used in the shop.<ref name="home" />

== History and community ==

An archived homepage from 2 October 2026 listed ''Young Jedi'', ''Stargate'' and ''Harry Potter''. It identified the Stargate and Harry Potter games as Kawoosh Online and Diagon Duels, which used separate accounts at the time.<ref name="october" /> The current homepage links to a Discord community for its games.<ref name="home" />
